name: Inverse Rendering with Inter-reflections (IRGS)
definition: An inverse-rendering framework that models inter-reflections by applying the full rendering equation without simplification, computing incident radiance on the fly via differentiable 2D Gaussian ray tracing. Fixes inaccurate material/lighting estimates of earlier methods.
summary: IRGS is an inverse rendering framework that jointly optimizes 3D Gaussian geometry and lighting by applying the full rendering equation with explicit inter-reflection modeling via differentiable ray tracing.
